How This Calculator Works

1. Monthly Payment Calculation
NAF = Finance Amount + All Financed Fees
Base PMT = PMT(NAF, Base Rate, Term, Balloon) → What lender charges
Final PMT = PMT(NAF, Contract Rate, Term, Balloon) → What customer pays
PMT (Arrears) = (NAF - PV_balloon) × [r(1+r)^n] ÷ [(1+r)^n - 1]
PMT (Advance) = PMT Arrears ÷ (1 + Monthly Rate)

Unlike capitalised brokerage, the customer's rate IS the contract rate - no commission is added to the principal.

2. Commission (Overs) Calculation
Base Total Hiring = Base PMT × Term
Final Total Hiring = Final PMT × Term
Hiring Difference = Final Total Hiring - Base Total Hiring
Overs Amount = Hiring Difference × 75% × 1.10 (GST)
Commission = MAX($110 base, Overs Amount)

Broker earns whichever is greater: the flat $110 base commission OR 75% + GST of the hiring difference. Not both - just the higher amount.

3. Why This Model Works Differently
Contract Rate: 8.00% → Customer sees this rate (no hidden commission)
Base Rate: 6.69% → What lender actually charges
Rate Markup: 1.31% → Broker's earning opportunity

The broker "dials up" the rate above base to earn commission. Higher markup = higher commission, but also higher customer payment.
